type.name: AccelerationStructureLevel
type.doc: Enumeration for the level of an acceleration structure in raytracing.

value.name: TopLevel
value.doc: Top-level acceleration structure, which contains instances of bottom-level structures.

value.name: BottomLevel
value.doc: Bottom-level acceleration structure, which contains geometry data such as triangles or AABBs.

type.name: GeometryType
type.doc: Enumeration for the type of geometry in a bottom-level acceleration structure.

value.name: Triangles
value.doc: Triangles geometry type. Used for triangle meshes.

value.name: AABBs
value.doc: Axis Aligned Bounding Boxes geometry type. Used for bounding volume hierarchies.

type.name: GeometryFlags
type.doc: Bitmask for geometry flags in raytracing.

value.name: None
value.doc: No flags set. Geometry is regular.

value.name: Opaque
value.doc: Geometry is opaque. Used for opaque geometry.

value.name: NoDuplicateAnyHitInvocation
value.doc: Geometry has no duplicate any hit invocation.

type.name: AccelerationStructureFlags
type.doc: Acceleration structure flags for additional acceleration structure features

value.name: None
value.doc: No flags set. Acceleration structure is regular.

value.name: AllowUpdate
value.doc: Acceleration structure is allowed to be updated.

value.name: AllowCompaction
value.doc: Acceleration structure is allowed to be compacted.

value.name: PreferFastTrace
value.doc: Acceleration structure is preferred to be fast traced.

value.name: PreferFastBuild
value.doc: Acceleration structure is preferred to be fast built.

value.name: MinimizeMemory
value.doc: Acceleration structure is minimized for memory usage.

value.name: PerformUpdate
value.doc: Acceleration structure build is performed as an update. Only used for update builds.

value.name: IndirectInput
value.doc: Acceleration structure build uses indirect input.

type.name: AccelerationStructureDesc
type.doc: Structure describing the properties of an acceleration structure.

member.name: level
member.doc: The level of the acceleration structure (top-level or bottom-level).

member.name: offset
member.doc: The offset in bytes from the start of the buffer where the acceleration structure is located.

member.name: size
member.doc: The size of the acceleration structure in bytes.

type.name: AcceleratedGeometryDesc
type.doc: Structure describing the single geometry instance.

member.name: type
member.doc: The type of geometry (triangles or AABBs).

member.name: flags
member.doc: The geometry flags for this geometry instance.

member.name: vertex_or_aabb_buffer_address
member.doc: The GPU address of the vertex buffer for this geometry instance.

member.name: index_buffer_address
member.doc: The GPU address of the index buffer for this geometry instance. Only used for triangles geometry type.

member.name: transform_matrix_address
member.doc: The GPU address of the transform matrix (float [3][4]) for this geometry instance. Only used for triangles geometry type.

member.name: vertex_or_aabb_stride
member.doc: The stride in bytes between vertices or AABBs in the buffer.

member.name: vertex_count
member.doc: The number of vertices in the vertex buffer. Only used for triangles geometry type.

member.name: triangle_or_aabb_count
member.doc: For triangles it is equal to (index_count/3) and count for AABBs.

member.name: vertex_format
member.doc: The format of the vertex data in the vertex buffer. Only used for triangles geometry type.

member.name: index_format
member.doc: The format of the index data in the index buffer. Only used for triangles geometry type.

type.name: StructureAllocationInfo
type.doc: Structure describing the allocation information for an acceleration structure.

member.name: structure_size
member.doc: The size of the acceleration structure in bytes.

member.name: scratch_size
member.doc: The size of the scratch buffer needed to build the acceleration structure in bytes.

member.name: update_size
member.doc: The size of the scratch buffer needed to update the acceleration structure in bytes.

type.name: BottomLevelStructureBuildDesc
type.doc: Structure describing the build description for a bottom-level acceleration structure.

member.name: flags
member.doc: The build flags for the acceleration structure build.

member.name: geometry_count
member.doc: The number of geometry instances in the bottom-level acceleration structure.

member.name: geometries
member.doc: The array of geometry descriptions for the bottom-level acceleration structure.

member.name: indirect_geometries
member.doc: The array of geometry descriptions for indirect build of the bottom-level acceleration structure. This input is ignored unless {AccelerationStructureFlags::IndirectInput} is specified.

type.name: TopLevelStructureBuildDesc
type.doc: Structure describing the build description for a top-level acceleration structure.

member.name: flags
member.doc: The build flags for the acceleration structure build.

member.name: instance_count
member.doc: The number of instances in the top-level acceleration structure.

member.name: instance_buffer_address
member.doc: The GPU address of the instance buffer for the top-level acceleration structure.

handle.name: AccelerationStructure
handle.doc: Handle for an acceleration structure used in raytracing.

func.name: Supported
func.doc: Checks if raytracing is supported on the current device.

ret.name: supported
ret.doc: true if raytracing is supported, false otherwise.

func.name: GetBottomLevelStructureInfo
func.doc: Retrieves the allocation information for a bottom-level acceleration structure based on the provided build description.

ret.name: info
ret.doc: The allocation information for the bottom-level acceleration structure.

arg.name: build_desc
arg.doc: The build description for the bottom-level acceleration structure.

func.name: GetTopLevelStructureInfo
func.doc: Retrieves the allocation information for a top-level acceleration structure based on the provided build description.

ret.name: info
ret.doc: The allocation information for the bottom-level acceleration structure.

arg.name: build_desc
arg.doc: The build description for the bottom-level acceleration structure.

func.name: CreateAccelerationStructures
func.doc: Creates a batch of acceleration structures based on the provided descriptions.

arg.name: buffer
arg.doc: The buffer to write the acceleration structure data to.

arg.name: structures
arg.doc: The descriptions of the acceleration structures to create.

arg.name: structure_count
arg.doc: The number of acceleration structures to create.

func.name: DestroyAccelerationStructures
func.doc: Destroys a batch of acceleration structures.

arg.name: structure_count
arg.doc: The number of acceleration structures to destroy.

func.name: GetGPUAddress
func.doc: Retrieves the GPU address of the acceleration structure.

ret.name: gpu_address
ret.doc: The GPU address of the acceleration structure.

value.name: AccelerationStructureAlignment
value.doc: Alignment in bytes for acceleration structure buffers. Acceleration structures must be allocated with this alignment and offset of the acceleration structure within the buffer must also be aligned to this value.
